description: This collection characterizes water and sediment contamination in Brazil’s Doce River Basin four years after the 2015 mining-dam collapse. Sao Paulo State University and laboratory collaborators collect triplicate samples at eight sites during the wet and dry seasons of 2019, yielding forty-eight samples of each environmental matrix. Trace elements, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, pyrethroids, sediment properties and earlier published comparison data are included. Mendeley version 4 lists eighteen Excel, PDF and ZIP files free under CC BY 4.0. Mining, industrial, domestic and agricultural inputs coexist along the river, so measured concentrations cannot be attributed solely to the dam failure. Two seasonal campaigns also limit temporal reconstruction. A reviewer-assessed use is checking contaminant-distribution assumptions or downstream recovery scenarios after infrastructure failure. model-hec-ras is a related hydraulic and sediment simulation tool, requiring additional chemical-process assumptions. No files, source-apportionment analysis or model calibration was executed.
